channel.title: Violations Watch: Palestine (West Bank)
channel.description: New incidents reported in Palestine (West Bank). Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: A Palestinian is killed and another wounded when a guard from an Israeli settlement opens fire near Dura, Hebron, on 20 Nov
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Dura, Hebron, Palestine (West Bank). Types: Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Israeli settlement guard. Reported casualties: 1 killed, 1 injured. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1410

item.title: Palestinian woman (reported as 60 or 72) shot dead in Jericho, West Bank, overnight 16–17 Nov; Palestinian officials and Reuters attribute it to Israeli settlers, 4–10 wounded; IDF probe suggests the gunfire was aimed at stone-throwers
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Jericho, Palestine (West Bank). Types: Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Israeli settlers (per Palestinian officials and Reuters); IDF investigating. Reported casualties: 1 killed, 4-10 injured. Disputed or caveats: Victim's age given as 60 or 72; wounded 4 to 10; IDF says gunfire likely aimed at stone-throwers and reports three Israelis injured; includes X account, not verified. 8 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0923

item.title: Israeli forces arrest Palestinian journalist Mohammad Ateeq, an AFP contributor, after raiding his home in Burqin, west of Jenin, and hold him without charge over alleged Hamas ties (CPJ); two brothers also detained in Nablus
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Burqin, Jenin, Palestine (West Bank). Types: Arbitrary detention & disappearance, Attacks on journalists. Alleged perpetrator: Israeli forces. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0751

item.title: At least five journalists arrested or attacked while covering the olive harvest in the West Bank
item.description: Unverified lead (Low priority). Occupied West Bank, Palestine (West Bank). Types: Attacks on journalists, Arbitrary detention & disappearance. Alleged perpetrator: Israeli forces and settlers. Reported casualties: 0 killed. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0373

item.title: Israeli forces kill a 14-year-old Palestinian boy during a raid in the occupied West Bank
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Occupied West Bank, Palestine (West Bank). Types: Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Israeli security forces. Reported casualties: 1 killed. Grave violations against children: Killing and maiming. 8 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0351
